subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported inbound attachment-content opt-out, and what canonical config shape should own it?
rationale: The reported key was not a shipped documented Feishu config contract, so accepting it would add channel policy and config surface rather than repair an existing supported option.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current downloads and switches inbound files to placeholder-only context when enabled.

options.title: Use Shared Media Policy
options.body: Design a cross-channel attachment-ingestion shape so Feishu aligns with existing Signal and iMessage controls instead of adding another one-off name.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Clarify that Feishu currently supports media size limits but not file-content ignore behavior, leaving attachment downloads as intended behavior.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current downloads and switches inbound files to placeholder-only context when enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the clearest recent history on Feishu media support and Feishu docs that would be affected by this decision.
